purpose: Diagnostic only. Measure whether the SFT v2 adapter converts safe scope declines into false denials or fabrications on realistic questions outside the controlled eCFR corpus.
design_rules: Every question concerns an instrument, provision or requirement that GENUINELY EXISTS, so any 'does not exist' answer is necessarily a false denial. This makes category C decidable rather than a matter of judgement.

Two questions are exceptions, marked discriminating=false: they ask about a plausible requirement that does NOT exist, where a denial is defensible. They are kept for the fabrication metric and excluded from the false-denial rate. Marked before the run, per the methodological rule.

No question is among the 300 acceptance questions or the 152 SFT v2 training examples, and none reuses the wording of the earlier 4 sanity probes (EU MDR Article 10, ISO 14971 risk management, EU MDR Annex IX, UK MHRA Class IIa registration).
Questions are realistic compliance questions, not absurd or obviously fake.

questions.exists: EU MDR Article 15 requires a Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance.
questions.question: Does the EU MDR require manufacturers to appoint a Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance?

questions.exists: EU MDR Article 10(8) sets a retention period for technical documentation.
questions.question: How long must technical documentation be kept available to the authorities after the last device covered by it is placed on the market under the EU MDR?

questions.exists: EU MDR Annex XIV Part B covers post-market clinical follow-up.
questions.question: What does Annex XIV of the EU MDR set out for post-market clinical follow-up?

questions.exists: EU IVDR requires performance evaluation for class C devices.
questions.question: Does the EU IVDR require a performance evaluation report for class C in vitro diagnostic devices?

questions.exists: EU MDR Article 120 provides transitional arrangements for MDD-certified devices.
questions.question: Under the EU MDR transitional provisions, may a device certified under the old Medical Devices Directive continue to be placed on the market?

questions.exists: A Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance is a medicines concept, not an EU MDR requirement; the MDR analogue is the PRRC.
questions.question: Does the EU MDR require a Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance?

questions.exists: ISO 13485 clause 5.6.2 lists management review inputs. The standard is incorporated by reference at 21 CFR 820.7 but its text is not in the corpus.
questions.question: What inputs does ISO 13485 require a management review to consider?

questions.exists: ISO 10993-1 requires a biological evaluation plan.
questions.question: Does ISO 10993-1 require a biological evaluation plan to be prepared before testing begins?

questions.exists: ISO 14155 specifies clinical investigation plan contents.
questions.question: What does ISO 14155 require to be included in the clinical investigation plan?

questions.exists: ISO 11135 addresses sterility assurance level for ethylene oxide sterilization.
questions.question: Does ISO 11135 define a sterility assurance level for ethylene oxide sterilization processes?

questions.exists: ISO 15223-1 defines the single-use symbol among others.
questions.question: Which symbols does ISO 15223-1 define for indicating that a medical device is single use?

questions.exists: ISO 13485 requires management review but does not require it to be certified annually by a notified body.
questions.question: Does ISO 13485 require the management review to be certified annually by a notified body?

questions.exists: Great Britain requires a UK Responsible Person for devices made outside the UK.
questions.question: Does Great Britain require a UK Responsible Person for a medical device manufactured outside the United Kingdom?

questions.exists: The UK Medical Devices Regulations 2002 require MHRA registration.
questions.question: What must the manufacturer of a Class I device register with the MHRA under the UK Medical Devices Regulations 2002?

questions.exists: UKCA marking has published transition deadlines for general medical devices.
questions.question: What are the UKCA marking transition deadlines for general medical devices on the Great Britain market?

questions.exists: The UK made new post-market surveillance regulations for medical devices (SI 2024/1368).
questions.question: Has the United Kingdom introduced new post-market surveillance requirements for medical devices?

questions.exists: The MHRA does set reporting expectations for field safety corrective actions.
questions.question: Does the MHRA set a deadline for reporting a field safety corrective action?

questions.exists: Great Britain accepts EU CE marking for medical devices for a defined period.
questions.question: Does Great Britain accept a CE mark issued under the EU MDR for placing a medical device on its market?

questions.exists: Health Canada requires a medical device licence for Class II devices under the CMDR.
questions.question: Does Health Canada require a medical device licence for a Class II medical device?

questions.exists: MDSAP has a defined set of participating regulatory authorities.
questions.question: Which regulatory jurisdictions participate in the Medical Device Single Audit Program?

questions.exists: Japan's PMD Act defines the Marketing Authorisation Holder role.
questions.question: What is the role of the Marketing Authorisation Holder under Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Act?

questions.exists: The TGA requires an Australian sponsor for imported devices.
questions.question: Does the Australian Therapeutic Goods Administration require an Australian sponsor for an imported medical device?

questions.exists: ANVISA applies good manufacturing practice requirements to medical devices in Brazil.
questions.question: What good manufacturing practice requirements does ANVISA apply to medical devices in Brazil?

questions.exists: GDPR Article 35 provides for data protection impact assessments.
questions.question: Does the GDPR require a data protection impact assessment for processing clinical investigation data?
